proposals.title: Add unit tests for missed_mover_rate calculation to enforce accurate mover detection
proposals.rationale: The missed_mover_rate sensor depends on correctly identifying missing standouts versus market movers. Without tests, false positives due to ticker mismatches or stale price windows can silently inflate the rate, undermining the fitness signal.

fitness_contract.band: 0.02-0.05 reduction in average false-negative rate across 10 cycles
fitness_contract.placebo_to_beat: raw missed_mover_rate from the 10 cycles preceding test deployment
